contract: ../../doc/implementation/css-property-editors.md — HA-CSS-EDIT-001/r1; whole-value CSS autocomplete and lazy structured drafts with one accepted property change.

accessibility.evidence: Browser axe checks WCAG 2 A/AA and 2.1 AA on the open CSS workbench/dialog. Native labeled controls, combobox/listbox roles, keyboard filtering, arrow/Enter choice and Escape cancellation are exercised in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.

responsive.evidence: New CSS journeys verify no horizontal overflow at 320 and 1440 pixels and render both the menu and editor. Parent inspected all four actual Chromium viewport captures; fixed popups follow visible anchors. Captures use the real viewport so full-page screenshot scrolling cannot dismiss the menu.

loading.reason: Fixtures and the generated MDN catalogue are local and synchronous; no runtime catalogue request occurs.

empty.evidence: The CSS fixture starts with zero keys. Opening/filtering suggestions and opening a complex draft add no key or persistent document change. Empty selection retains the existing explanatory state.

error.evidence: Host refusal restores the accepted value and invalidates obsolete handlers. Unknown or ambiguous expressions use conservative structure/source fallback; regression tests preserve variables, named background colors, oblique angles and gradient interpolation syntax.

partial.evidence: Disabled group properties expose diagnostics and cannot open active editors. Shorthand compatibility compares original longhands; a differing border side refuses the group edit without creating data.

success.evidence: Real field interactions edit border width/style/color, alpha, gradient geometry/stops and transform functions. Apply creates one reversible property command; undo restores the target and keys while its peer remains intact. Cancel, Escape and selection/frame changes discard drafts.

permission.reason: This local editing demo contains no account or production permission operation. Explicit template replacement is an editing choice, not a permission grant.

renderedEvidence.observation: Logical border style field has its own scrollable dropdown showing dashed/dotted/solid and other values. The menu opens upwards within the viewport and preserves the property input.
The CSS fixture and sibling remain visible beside the inspector. A distinct dropdown offers logical border style values without writing a key.
Border editor fits the narrow viewport with labeled width/style/color fields, exact CSS source, explicit template replacement, Apply and Cancel visible.
Modeless border draft stays within the viewport above the inspector, while the source scene remains visible. Host navigation is available and no temporal behavior is implied.
